title: The ONDS Disconnect: a defence prime in the making, priced like a problem
teaser: Ondas has never had more good news, yet the shares trade at well under half their January high. What Ondas has become, what shareholders paid for it, and what would make the price follow the business.

title: Nebius: Sizing up the Opportunity
teaser: Independent research and one Wall Street bank suggest Nebius could be much bigger by the end of 2027 than most forecasts assume. We test that research and explain it in plain English.
